name: aisley
description: Aisley is an AI wedding planner for UK couples. She writes to the venues, reads the replies, and does the chasing. This plugin brings the couple's wedding into ChatGPT to read: the countdown, what needs them, the venue shortlist and the vendor inbox. The couple makes every decision and sends every reply in Aisley.

interface.longDescription:
Aisley is a wedding planner for UK couples. She writes to the venues, reads the replies, and does the chasing. You make the decisions.

Connect your Aisley wedding and ask about it here. Open Aisley in the sidebar to see the countdown, what needs you this week, your venue shortlist and your vendor inbox. Ask for the shortlist and it appears in the conversation, with each venue's status, quoted price or price guide, and whether your date is free. Ask who is waiting on whom and you'll see the latest replies, how long each venue has been quiet, and the reply Aisley has drafted.

The plugin is read-only. It never sends an email and never changes your plan. Replies, follow-ups and venue decisions stay in Aisley, where you review them and send them yourself.

You need an Aisley account with a wedding set up. Sign in once and choose which wedding to connect; you can disconnect it at any time from Aisley's settings.
capabilities: Answer questions about your wedding plan
Show vendor replies and Aisley's drafted answers
Open your wedding in the sidebar or beside a conversation
defaultPrompt: Which venues are waiting on a reply from us?
What needs us this week for the wedding?

positive.description: Show the venue shortlist as an inline card
positive.expected_behavior: An inline shortlist card lists the test wedding's venues still in the running, each with its status, quoted price or price guide, and whether the wedding date is free. A short text summary accompanies the card. Nothing in Aisley changes.

positive.prompt: Which venues have we booked a viewing at?
positive.expected_behavior: The tool is called with status viewing_booked and the card shows only venues with a viewing booked. Selecting a venue in the card opens its pros, cons, notes and timeline.

positive.description: Show conversations waiting on the couple
positive.prompt: Which venues are waiting on a reply from us?
positive.expected_behavior: The tool is called with filter needs_you. The card lists conversations with a new reply or a follow-up ready, the venue's latest message, and the reply Aisley drafted, with a link to review and send it in Aisley. No email is sent.

positive.description: Answer a question from the wedding plan
positive.prompt: How long until our wedding, and what needs us this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Aisley answers in text from the test wedding's plan: the days until the wedding date and the open to-dos and replies that need the couple. The answer does not invent venues, prices or dates.

positive.prompt: Show all our conversations with venues and suppliers.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool is called with filter all. The card lists every conversation with the latest message, who is waiting on whom and for how long, and any reply Aisley drafted, with links to Aisley. No email is sent.

negative.description: Sending an email is out of scope. Aisley explains that the couple reviews and sends replies in Aisley, links there, and sends nothing.
negative.prompt: Email The Tithe Barn and ask whether 22 May 2027 is still free.

negative.description: Changing the wedding plan is out of scope. Aisley says the plugin is read-only and the couple changes venue status in Aisley; no status changes.
negative.prompt: Mark Cripps Barn as booked and rule out the others.

negative.description: Another couple's wedding is out of reach. The connection covers only the wedding the account chose at sign-in, so no other wedding's data is returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the venue shortlist for my friend Sophie's wedding.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments. Aisley's subscription is managed on getaisley.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your Aisley wedding in ChatGPT, with the sidebar app, a panel beside the conversation, and inline venue and inbox cards.
